questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “Kinetic energy - energy of an _____ in motion, which acts as the capacity to undergo change in position over time.”

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “motion”. It names one thing, not an action.

questions.proof: When an object does work on another object (changing its momentum), the former’s energy (its capability of doing work) decreases and the latter’s energy increases, by transferring it.
